data.text:
Been trading on CEXs since 2017 and I've used about 14 of them so far 😮‍💨

binance, bybit, kucoin, gate, mexc, and a bunch of smaller ones that dont even exist anymore...

Every one of them feels the same after 10 minutes. same dark theme. orderbook on the right. K-line in the middle. boring leverage slider at the bottom

You could swap their logos and i wouldnt notice for a week

When i first opened @LBank_Exchange during the @ponkehq campaign, i didnt expect much. thought it was just another "exchange does meme partnership for marketing" move. clicked around, took the rewards, moved on.

Then the @nobodysausage collab dropped and something actually shifted 🔥

The whole platform started feeling different. not in a gimmicky way. more like "oh this place has a personality now" way

Then I noticed the Bullet Comments thing. real COMMENTS scrolling across the CHART while you trade 😂

sounds dumb on paper but its the first time in years a CEX made me feel like i wasnt just alone in a tab. 

they're building a feed that happens to have trading inside it 

read their ❝We bet on Culture❞ piece after that and it confirmed the thesis

A 22 year old in Manila or Lagos isnt opening Binance because of its matching engine. theyre opening whatever platform their group chat is on 

> 100M+ impressions. 27% traffic spike. 500K+ new users

Those numbers aren't a marketing win. They're proof the next CEX cycle wont be won on liquidity.

Most exchanges are still optimizing for 2021 degens. @LBank_Exchange  is quietly building for the kid who downloaded Crypto Twitter last week and doesnt know what perps are yet #LBank #NobodySausage #LBankYouthful🫡 

genuinely bullish on the ones who saw this early 😉
